_comment: Crash signatures of the audited pyte defects, keyed by org-ai-assisted/pyte-audit finding id. fuzz_pyte.py tolerates a signature only while the tree under test does NOT declare that id fixed in its pyte-audit-fixes.txt manifest, so a fixed defect that comes back is reported as a new finding instead of staying allowlisted forever. Signature format: 'ExcType|file:function|normalized-message'.

A: TypeError|streams.py:_parser_fsm|Screen.F() takes N positional arguments but N were given
TypeError|streams.py:_parser_fsm|Screen.F() takes from N to N positional arguments but N were
C: UnboundLocalError|screens.py:erase_in_display|cannot access local variable 'X' where it is not associated
UnboundLocalError|screens.py:erase_in_line|cannot access local variable 'X' where it is not associated
